_about: Plain-language text for every metric of the Mutual Fund Health Score (spec Section 9). {own} is the fund's own figure, {peer} the peer median it was measured against, {value} the measured gap (absolute), {n} the number of peer funds, {why} a short note. fmt says how each placeholder is written. The words describe; they never advise. Edit the text here, not in code.

RET_1Y_REL.label: 1-year return against similar funds
RET_1Y_REL.strong: Its 1-year return of {own} is {value} above the median of {n} similar funds ({peer}).
RET_1Y_REL.weak: Its 1-year return of {own} is {value} below the median of {n} similar funds ({peer}).

RET_3Y_REL.label: 3-year return against similar funds
RET_3Y_REL.strong: Its 3-year return of {own} a year is {value} above the median of {n} similar funds ({peer}).
RET_3Y_REL.weak: Its 3-year return of {own} a year is {value} below the median of {n} similar funds ({peer}).

RET_5Y_REL.label: 5-year return against similar funds
RET_5Y_REL.strong: Its 5-year return of {own} a year is {value} above the median of {n} similar funds ({peer}).
RET_5Y_REL.weak: Its 5-year return of {own} a year is {value} below the median of {n} similar funds ({peer}).

RET_ABS.label: Return on its own
RET_ABS.strong: Its long-term return of {own} a year is high for a fund of this kind.
RET_ABS.weak: Its long-term return of {own} a year is low for a fund of this kind.

SIP_REL.label: Monthly-SIP return against similar funds
SIP_REL.strong: A monthly SIP in it earned {own} a year, {value} above the median of {n} similar funds ({peer}).
SIP_REL.weak: A monthly SIP in it earned {own} a year, {value} below the median of {n} similar funds ({peer}).

HIT_RATE.label: Months it matched similar funds
HIT_RATE.strong: It did at least as well as the median similar fund in {value} of the months compared ({why}).
HIT_RATE.weak: It did at least as well as the median similar fund in only {value} of the months compared ({why}).

VOL_RATIO.label: Size of price swings
VOL_RATIO.strong: Its month-to-month swings (volatility {own} a year) are smaller than the median of {n} similar funds ({peer}): {value} of it.
VOL_RATIO.weak: Its month-to-month swings (volatility {own} a year) are larger than the median of {n} similar funds ({peer}): {value} of it.

DD_RATIO.label: Biggest fall against similar funds
DD_RATIO.strong: Its biggest month-end fall over three years, {own}, is smaller than the similar-fund median of {peer}.
DD_RATIO.weak: Its biggest month-end fall over three years, {own}, is deeper than the similar-fund median of {peer}.

DOWN_CAPTURE.label: How it behaved when similar funds fell
DOWN_CAPTURE.strong: In months when similar funds fell (by {peer} on average), it fell by {own}: {value} of their fall.
DOWN_CAPTURE.weak: In months when similar funds fell (by {peer} on average), it fell by {own}: {value} of their fall.

SHARPE_REL.label: Return for each unit of price swing
SHARPE_REL.strong: Its return per unit of swing (Sharpe ratio {own}) is {value} above the similar-fund median ({peer}).
SHARPE_REL.weak: Its return per unit of swing (Sharpe ratio {own}) is {value} below the similar-fund median ({peer}).

SHARPE_ABS.label: Return for each unit of price swing
SHARPE_ABS.strong: Its return per unit of price swing (Sharpe ratio {own}) is high.
SHARPE_ABS.weak: Its return per unit of price swing (Sharpe ratio {own}) is low.

WORST12_REL.label: Worst year against similar funds
WORST12_REL.strong: Its worst 12-month stretch ({own}) was milder than the similar-fund median ({peer}).
WORST12_REL.weak: Its worst 12-month stretch ({own}) was harsher than the similar-fund median ({peer}).

WORST_MONTH.label: Worst single month
WORST_MONTH.strong: Its worst month in the last three years was {own}, mild for this kind of fund.
WORST_MONTH.weak: Its worst month in the last three years was {own}, deep for this kind of fund.

MDD_ABS.label: Biggest fall
MDD_ABS.strong: Its biggest month-end fall over three years was {own}, small for this kind of fund.
MDD_ABS.weak: Its biggest month-end fall over three years was {own}, large for this kind of fund.

NEG_MONTHS.label: Months with a loss
NEG_MONTHS.strong: It lost money in only {own} of the months.
NEG_MONTHS.weak: It lost money in {own} of the months.

UNDERWATER.label: Time below its previous high
UNDERWATER.strong: It spent only {own} of the last three years below its previous high.
UNDERWATER.weak: It spent {own} of the last three years below its previous high.

CALMAR.label: Return against its biggest fall
CALMAR.strong: Its return of {own} a year is large compared with its biggest fall (ratio {value}).
CALMAR.weak: Its return of {own} a year is small compared with its biggest fall (ratio {value}).

TER_VS_PEER.label: Expense ratio against similar funds
TER_VS_PEER.strong: Its expense ratio of {own} a year is lower than the median of {n} similar funds ({peer}).
TER_VS_PEER.weak: Its expense ratio of {own} a year is higher than the median of {n} similar funds ({peer}).

TER_ABS.label: Expense ratio on its own
TER_ABS.strong: Its expense ratio of {own} a year is low for this plan.
TER_ABS.weak: Its expense ratio of {own} a year is high for this plan.

FEE_SHARE.label: Share of return paid in costs
FEE_SHARE.strong: Costs ({own} a year) take about {value} of the return before costs.
FEE_SHARE.weak: Costs ({own} a year) take about {value} of the return before costs.

AGE.label: Track record
AGE.strong: It has a track record of {own}.

SIZE_FIT.label: Fund size
SIZE_FIT.strong: Its fund size of {own} is in a steady range for this kind of fund.
SIZE_FIT.weak: Its fund size of {own} is outside the range the model treats as steady for this kind of fund.

EQUITY_INVESTED.label: Share invested in shares
EQUITY_INVESTED.strong: {own} of its assets are invested in shares, as an equity fund's label says.
EQUITY_INVESTED.weak: Only {own} of its assets are invested in shares, with the rest held in other assets or cash.

TOP10_CONC_REL.label: Ten largest holdings
TOP10_CONC_REL.strong: Its ten largest holdings are {own} of net assets, less concentrated than the median of {peer}.
TOP10_CONC_REL.weak: Its ten largest holdings are {own} of net assets, more concentrated than the median of {peer}.

SECTOR_CONC_REL.label: Largest sector
SECTOR_CONC_REL.strong: Its largest sector is {own} of net assets, below the median of {peer}.
SECTOR_CONC_REL.weak: Its largest sector is {own} of net assets, above the median of {peer}.

ASSET_FIT_DEBT.label: Debt fund holds what its label says
ASSET_FIT_DEBT.strong: Only {own} of its assets sit in shares or other non-debt holdings, in line with a debt fund.
ASSET_FIT_DEBT.weak: {own} of its assets sit in shares or other non-debt holdings, more than a debt fund's label suggests.

ALLOC_FIT.label: Equity share against similar funds
ALLOC_FIT.strong: Its equity share of {own} is close to the median of similar funds ({peer}).
ALLOC_FIT.weak: Its equity share of {own} is {value} away from the median of similar funds ({peer}).

RISKOMETER_REL.label: Regulator risk level against similar funds
RISKOMETER_REL.strong: Its risk-o-meter level is {own}, {value} below the similar-fund median ({peer}).
RISKOMETER_REL.weak: Its risk-o-meter level is {own}, {value} above the similar-fund median ({peer}).

ETF_LIQUIDITY.label: How easily it trades
ETF_LIQUIDITY.strong: It trades about {own} a day on the exchange.
ETF_LIQUIDITY.weak: It trades only about {own} a day on the exchange.

ETF_PREMIUM.label: Price against NAV
ETF_PREMIUM.strong: Its exchange price stayed within {value} of its NAV on the NAV date.
ETF_PREMIUM.weak: Its exchange price was {value} away from its NAV on the NAV date.

gaps.history_short: the fund is too young for this measure (it needs a 3 or 5 year history)
gaps.no_peers: too few similar funds had this figure to compare against
gaps.window_broken: too many month-end NAVs were missing or invalid in the last 36 months
gaps.frozen_nav: the NAV barely moved for three years, which looks like a stale or frozen NAV
gaps.under_12_months_compared: fewer than 12 months could be compared with similar funds
gaps.under_12_months: the fund has less than 12 months of returns
gaps.fall_zero: a month-end fall of exactly 0 over 36 months is not credible for this kind of fund, so it is treated as missing
gaps.fall_unavailable: the month-end fall could not be worked out
gaps.ter_zero: expense ratio reported as 0, a placeholder, so it is treated as missing
gaps.ter_stale: the expense ratio on file is older than 45 days
gaps.exit_load_unreadable: the exit load text could not be read with confidence
gaps.aum_zero: fund size reported as 0, which means it did not load, so it is treated as missing
gaps.portfolio_missing: the fund house's portfolio file is not loaded
gaps.equity_zero: the equity share came as 0, a failed read of the portfolio file, so it is treated as missing
gaps.top10_zero: the top-10 share came as 0, a failed read of the portfolio file, so it is treated as missing
gaps.sector_zero: the largest-sector share came as 0, a failed read of the portfolio file, so it is treated as missing
gaps.split_unparsed: the asset split in the portfolio file did not add up to at least 50%, so it is treated as missing
gaps.risk_unreadable: the risk-o-meter wording could not be read
gaps.no_trade_on_nav_date: the ETF did not trade on the NAV date, so a premium cannot be measured

na.passive: not used for index funds and ETFs: their return is set by their index
na.lock_in: not used for funds with a lock-in
na.fewer_than_6_down_months: fewer than 6 months in which similar funds fell, so it cannot be measured
na.not_in_sheet: does not apply to this kind of fund

substitutes.r5y: the 5-year figure was not available, so the 3-year figure was used
substitutes.r3y: the 3-year figure stood in for a missing 5-year figure
substitutes.r1y: the 1-year figure stood in for a missing 3-year figure
substitutes.sip3y: the 3-year SIP stood in for a missing 5-year SIP
substitutes.launch_date_missing: the launch date is not on file, so the NAV history length was used
substitutes.launch_date_impossible: the launch date on file is not possible, so the NAV history length was used

peerSets.sub: funds in the same category and plan
peerSets.grp: funds in the wider group and the same plan (too few in the category)
